description: This header file declares exported API functions for a Pointer Array object related to a component in the BroadWay Service Delivery System, including creation, removal, enrollment, and initialization functions.

methods.name: AnscCreatePtrArrayComponent
methods.description: Creates a pointer array component within the specified container and owner context.

methods.name: AnscPtrArrayCOCreate
methods.description: Creates an instance of the pointer array object with given contexts.

methods.name: AnscPtrArrayCORemove
methods.description: Removes the pointer array object instance.

methods.name: AnscPtrArrayCOEnrollObjects
methods.description: Enrolls necessary objects into the pointer array component.
